colmap.undistortion_status: already undistorted; only PINHOLE model is present

dataset_name: MatrixCity Small City aerial block_all_test reconstruction
dataset_role: first bounded official-source ALoD training smoke, .dhier generation, and format/selection/rendering oracle asset; not a performance baseline
excluded_files: training outputs, checkpoints, Gaussian PLYs, and .dhier assets
formal_evaluation_contamination_warning: This asset is derived from MatrixCity's original aerial test reconstruction. Because most of its cameras are repurposed for ALoD training, it must not be used as an untouched MatrixCity test set or compared directly with formal results that preserve the original MatrixCity train/test protocol.

image_link.broken_link_validation: link resolves, every registered file exists, every PNG passes integrity verification, and all required representative images fully decode
image_link.reason: avoid duplicating 3,030,193,206 bytes of third-party image payload

image_loader_compatibility.official_camera_behavior: PILtoTorch converts HWC uint8 to float CHW in [0,1]. With no external mask, Camera uses channel 3 as alpha, keeps channels 0:3 as RGB, and multiplies RGB by alpha without background compositing. With resolution=-1, 1920x1080 inputs are LANCZOS-resized to 1600x900.
image_loader_compatibility.representative_policy: all 15 evaluation images plus the early, middle, and late stable sorted images

license.permitted_use: non-commercial research with attribution; ShareAlike applies to CityGaussian-derived reconstruction material
license.redistribution: Do not redistribute image or COLMAP payloads from this repository; preserve hashes and regeneration instructions. Any external redistribution must satisfy both source licenses.

prohibited_uses: direct PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS comparison with existing CityGaussian formal results

project_use: repurposed for ALoD smoke training and oracle generation

sparse_ply_generation.algorithm: read points3D.bin in file order; emit x/y/z float32, zero nx/ny/nz float32, and red/green/blue uint8 using plyfile binary little-endian output

split.semantics: stable registered-image name sort; zero-based index; evaluation when index % llff_hold == 0; all remaining images train

suitability.hierarchy_selection_oracle_creation: conditionally suitable; non-trivial depth/LoD variation remains unverified until a hierarchy exists
